input: Completed original five-fold R16 train OOF scores only, using each system's already selected per-fold window and answer thresholds.
identity: Require exact metadata, labels, eligibility, original fold membership, and one outer fold per group. Each answer score is max over all its original candidate windows.
analysis: For positive and negative eligible windows/answers, count both predicted risk, base only, large only, neither. Separately count the same intersection on reviewed safe refusals. Preserve cell IDs and distinct source-group counts.
selection: None: no threshold search, new score combination, oracle F1, training, or GPU.
limits: Repeated R16 development with human_gold=false. Old R16 heldouts were exposed historically; they are not read in this analysis. Public official QA test is not read. Disagreement of two completed systems does not isolate model size, upstream initialization/training, semantic information, or different selected fusion weights, and does not establish trainable fusion benefit.
